title: ElevenLabs Agent Voice Settings: Speed, Expressive Mode, Pronunciation
desc:
ElevenLabs tutorial: ElevenLabs Agent Voice Settings: Speed, Expressive Mode, Pronunciation.

Your agent's voice is more than picking a voice. This episode covers speed control and its 0.7 to 1.2 range, expressive mode with Eleven v3 Conversational and the new turn-taking system, how to steer emotion from the system prompt with expressive tags, pronunciation dictionaries with IPA, CMU and alias tags, and multi-voice support for tutoring and storytelling agents, including the limits and mistakes the docs warn about.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
